scope: Unmodified upstream research-model feasibility and conservation examples only. Fuel internally commanded; engine speed forced. Neither our ECU nor Speeduino controls these runs.
license_note: Repository root LICENSE says GPL-2.0; Modelica source headers say GPL-3.0-or-later. Do not redistribute derived source without resolving this upstream inconsistency.
limitations: Stock SIEngine computes fuel from air flow and has no ignition-angle/pulse interface.
Needs a reviewed actuation/FMI adapter before ECU closed-loop comparisons.
Initialization, unit annotations and small negative species-mass assertions need investigation.
No calibration for the intended engine, no hardware timing or physical qualification.
